nibiru.noteFar: A WORLD WIT NO SUN, FALLIN' IN OUT OF DA DARK ON A COURSE NOBODY PLOTTED AN' NOBODY CAN BEND. DA EPHEMERIDES PUT IT OVER EARTH ON DA TWENTY-FIRST OF DECEMBER, 2012!
nibiru.noteNear: INSIDE DA SYSTEM NOW, AN' NO LONGER SLOWIN'. IT HOLDS EARTH'S OWN ANGLE EXACTLY, WHICH IZ ANOTHER WAY OF SAYIN' IT IZ NOT GOING TA MISS!
nibiru.saturnNote: NIBIRU WENT INTO DA GIANT INSTEAD, AN' DA GIANT CAUGHT. SATURN BURNS NOW: NOT ENOUGH TA BE A STAR, FAR TOO MUCH TA STILL BE A PLANET. DA RINGS WENT FIRST!
nibiru.towerNote: WHERE EARTH STOOD DERE IZ A BLACK LANCE TWELVE KILOMETRES TALL, GOLD AT EVERY EDGE, TURNIN' IN DA ORBIT ITS WORLD LEFT BEHIND. NOTHIN' ON IT ANSWERS, AN' ONE DOOR IZ OPEN!

nibiru.hitEarth: NIBIRU HAB STRUCK DA EARTH. BOTH IZ GONE!

hubbleQuest.title: REFIT OF DA HUBBLE SPACE TELESCOPE
hubbleQuest.body: DA OLD OBSERVATORY IZ STILL UP DERE, HOLDIN' ITS ONE ASTRONOMICAL UNIT ORBIT AN' POINTIN' AT NOTHIN'. HALF ITS ASSEMBLIES IZ DEAD, DA REST IZ RUNNIN' ON DEY MARGINS, AN' DA DOWNLINK HAB BEEN QUIET FOR YEARS. BRING DA SHIP ALONGSIDE, OPEN DA SERVICIN' BAY AN' PUT DA TELESCOPE BACK TA WORK ONE ASSEMBLY AT A TIME!
hubbleQuest.objectives: RESTORE EVERY ASSEMBLY OF DA HUBBLE SPACE TELESCOPE FROM DA SHIP'S SERVICIN' BAY!
terms: DA BAY ONLY OPENS WHILE DA SHIP HOLDS STATION IN DA TELESCOPE'S ORBIT, IN DA SOL SYSTEM!
EVERY REPAIR IZ PAID FOR IN CRAFTIN' MATERIALS, AN' A WORSE FAULT COSTS MORE!
NOTHIN' HERE IZ TIMED: A HALF-SERVICED TELESCOPE STAYS HALF-SERVICED!
hubbleQuest.reward: DEEP FIELD IMAGIN': DOUBLE RANGE ON DA BIOSIGNATURE SWEEP

bodyNote.2060chiron: COMET OR ASTEROID, DEPENDIN' WHICH YEAR YOU ASK. IT GREW A COMA IN 1988, AFTER A DECADE FILED AS A MINOR PLANET, AN' DA ARGUMENT HAB NOT BEEN SETTLED SINCE!
bodyNote.3753cruithne: EARTH'S SECOND MOON, IF YOU IZ GENEROUS. A HORSESHOE CO-ORBITAL DAT TAKES 770 YEARS TA WALK ONE LAP OF ITS BEAN-SHAPED PATH AROUND US, AN' IZ NEVER CAPTURED!
bodyNote.433eros: NEAR SHOEMAKER TOUCHED DOWN HERE ON 12 FEBRUARY 2001, A SPACECRAFT NEVER DESIGNED TA LAND ON ANYTHIN'. IT KEPT TRANSMITTIN' FROM DA SURFACE FOR A FORTNIGHT!
bodyNote.antichthon: PHILOLAUS PLACED A COUNTER-EARTH OPPOSITE OUR OWN, FOREVER BEHIND DA SUN, TA ROUND DA COUNT OF MOVIN' BODIES UP TA TEN. EVERY PROBE SENT TA CHECK HAB BEEN AIMED SOMEWHERE ELSE!
bodyNote.earth: DA SHELL AROUND IT IZ NOT DECORATION. FORTY YEARS OF SPENT UPPER STAGES, DEAD SATELLITES AN' FROZEN COOLANT, EVERY COLLISION BREEDIN' DA FRAGMENTS FOR DA NEXT ONE!
bodyNote.hubblespacetelescope: LAUNCHED 1990 WIT A PRIMARY MIRROR GROUND TA DA WRONG PRESCRIPTION BY TWO MICRONS. THREE SERVICIN' MISSIONS HAB BEEN FLOWN TA IT. IT NEEDS A FOURTH!
bodyNote.moon2: DA SECOND MOON KEEPS A FIVE DAY WEEK. IT IZ UP DERE ON A FRIDAY, FULL AN' UNHURRIED, AN' ON EVERY OTHER DAY DA SKY WHERE IT SHOULD BE IZ EMPTY. NO EPHEMERIS IN PRINT ADMITS IT!
bodyNote.moon3: DA THIRD RISES WIT DA SECOND AN' SETS WIT IT, FURTHER OUT AN' SMALLER, AN' HAB NEVER BEEN PHOTOGRAPHED ON A THURSDAY. DA TWO OF DEM IZ ALWAYS IN DA SAME PHASE AS EACH OTHER AN' NEVER IN DA MOON'S!
bodyNote.pioneer10: LAUNCHED 1972. IT KEEPS FALLIN' SHORT OF WHERE DA ARITHMETIC SAYS IT SHOULD BE, BY A HAIR, EVERY YEAR. CARRIES A GOLD PLAQUE OF TWO NAKED STRANGERS WAVIN'!
bodyNote.pioneer11: LAUNCHED 1973, FIRST TA SATURN. LAST CONTACT 30 NOVEMBER 1995: DA TRANSMITTER IZ DEAD, DA TRAJECTORY IZ EXACT, AN' DA PLAQUE ABOARD IZ STILL LEGIBLE TA NOBODY!
bodyNote.russellsteapot: CHINA, ELLIPTICAL ORBIT BETWEEN EARTH AN' MARS, TOO SMALL FOR DA MOST POWERFUL TELESCOPE TA CONFIRM. DA BURDEN OF PROOF IZ NOT ON DA OBSERVER. CONFIRMED!
bodyNote.titania: ONE OCEAN, ALL OF IT ACID, WRAPPED AROUND A HOLE FOUR HUNDRED THOUSAND TIMES DA SUN. DA DARGOS LIVE ON DA WATER AN' REFER TA DA HOLE AS DA NEIGHBOUR. HUMANITY HAB HAB A STANDIN' INVITATION HERE SINCE 1977 AN' NOBODY ON TITANIA HAB YET STOPPED FINDIN' DAT FUNNY!
bodyNote.tma2: A BLACK SLAB IN JUPITER SPACE, ITS EDGES IN DA EXACT RATIO 1:4:9 TA DA LIMIT OF MEASUREMENT. EVERY INSTRUMENT AIMED AT IT RETURNS DA REFLECTANCE OF NOTHIN' AT ALL!
bodyNote.voyager1: DA FURTHEST HUMAN OBJECT FROM DA SUN, RETURNIN' 160 BITS A SECOND FROM DA EDGE OF DA HELIOSPHERE. DA GOLDEN RECORD IZ BOLTED TA ITS FLANK, NEVER ONCE PLAYED!
bodyNote.voyager2: LAUNCHED 1977, DA ONLY CRAFT TA PASS ALL FOUR GIANTS. ITS PLASMA INSTRUMENT IZ STILL SWITCHED ON. NOBODY AT DA DEEP SPACE NETWORK HAB EVER HAB A REASON TA SWITCH IT OFF!
bodyNote.vulcan: DA PLANET LE VERRIER PUT INSIDE MERCURY'S ORBIT IN 1859 TA EXPLAIN DA WANDERIN' OF MERCURY'S PERIHELION. GENERAL RELATIVITY EXPLAINED IT INSTEAD. VULCAN WAZ NEVER WITHDRAWN, ONLY STOPPED BEING LOOKED FOR!
